description: Set how this shop's quotes, invoices and emails to customers look, on the customer's page, in the PDF and in every email (owner only). The owner can also change it on the brand page at /p/shop/brand. Send only what changes; null clears a field. accent_color is "#rrggbb" and must reach 4.5 to 1 contrast on white (the default is #1f4fd1). logo_base64 is a PNG or JPEG of up to 5 MB, stored as a JPEG of at most 600 pixels on its long side. sent_with_doing_work (on by default) prints "Sent with Doing Work" in the PDF footer, on the page and at the bottom of emails.

accent_color.description: "#rrggbb", dark enough to read on white. null goes back to the default.

footer.description: Up to 300 characters printed at the bottom, such as payment terms or a thank you.

logo_base64.description: A PNG or JPEG file, base64. null removes the logo.

name: shops_setBrand
